title: Director of Manufacturing Operations
text:
**About the Role**

* We are seeking an experienced, hands-on
 **Director of Manufacturing**
 to lead operations at an established U.S. manufacturing facility specializing in electrical equipment, industrial cabinets and enclosures, metal fabrication, and assembly.
* The ideal candidate will bring strong manufacturing leadership experience, preferably within electrical cabinet manufacturing, data and telecommunications cabinets, electrical enclosures, power distribution equipment, or related electromechanical assembly environments.
* This individual will oversee day-to-day plant operations, ensuring production targets, quality standards, safety requirements, and customer delivery commitments are consistently achieved.
* This is a critical leadership opportunity for a proven manufacturing professional who can improve operational performance, strengthen on-time delivery, implement process improvements, and develop a high-performing workforce.
* We are looking for a leader who is comfortable on the production floor, understands the complexities of fabrication and assembly operations, and can effectively manage production schedules, workforce productivity, and operational priorities.

**Salary Range: $180K - $230K + Yearly Bonus + Relocation package**

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Operational Leadership**

* Oversee daily manufacturing operations, including machining, metal fabrication, painting, electrical and mechanical assembly, warehousing, quality, and maintenance.
* Lead production involving electrical cabinets, data cabinets, industrial enclosures, and related electrical equipment.
* Manage manufacturing workflows from raw material processing and fabrication through finishing, component integration, assembly, inspection, and final shipment.
* Provide visible, hands-on leadership by working directly with production supervisors, manufacturing teams, and technical personnel.
* Coordinate production schedules, labor resources, materials, and equipment availability to meet customer demand and delivery commitments.
* Partner with domestic and international manufacturing teams to optimize production capacity and resource utilization.
* Identify production bottlenecks and implement solutions to improve throughput and on-time delivery.

**Manufacturing, Fabrication & Assembly**

* Oversee manufacturing processes involving sheet metal fabrication, machining, welding, painting, and industrial equipment assembly.
* Ensure efficient production and assembly of electrical cabinets, control enclosures, data cabinets, and related industrial products.
* Understand manufacturing processes involving electrical component installation, equipment integration, wiring, and mechanical assembly.
* Partner with engineering and production teams to address manufacturing challenges, improve product quality, and optimize assembly procedures.
* Ensure production teams follow engineering drawings, manufacturing specifications, quality procedures, and customer requirements.
* Identify opportunities to improve fabrication and assembly efficiency, reduce rework, and strengthen first-pass quality.

**Continuous Improvement & Operational Efficiency**

* Drive Lean manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives to improve productivity, reduce waste, and optimize plant performance.
* Develop and monitor operational KPIs covering safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and cost.
* Implement effective production planning, workflow management, and resource allocation processes.
* Utilize ERP systems, manufacturing data, and operational reporting to improve scheduling accuracy and decision-making.
* Build a flexible and accountable manufacturing organization capable of responding to changing customer demands and production requirements.

**Safety, Quality & Compliance**

* Promote a safety-first culture across all manufacturing departments.
* Ensure compliance with OSHA, environmental, and applicable manufacturing safety standards.
* Maintain and strengthen ISO 9001 quality management processes and applicable environmental and occupational health and safety management systems.
* Work closely with quality and production teams to reduce defects, improve inspection procedures, and minimize customer complaints.
* Support facility improvements, equipment upgrades, and workplace safety initiatives.

**People Leadership & Culture:**

* Lead, coach, and develop production supervisors, manufacturing personnel, and operational support teams.
* Establish clear performance expectations and accountability throughout the organization.
* Partner with Human Resources to improve employee engagement, retention, training, and workforce development.
* Foster a collaborative, hands-on culture focused on safety, operational excellence, continuous improvement, and customer satisfaction.
* Build a strong leadership team capable of maintaining consistent production performance.

**Strategic & Financial Management:**

* Develop and execute plant operating strategies aligned with company objectives.
* Manage operating budgets, labor costs, manufacturing expenses, and capital improvement initiatives.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, reduce production costs, and strengthen profitability.
* Collaborate with senior leadership and global manufacturing partners on production planning, resource allocation, and long-term operational improvements.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 10–15 years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, including significant responsibility for plant operations, production management, or manufacturing operations.
* Experience managing manufacturing environments involving electrical cabinets, data cabinets, telecommunications enclosures, electrical equipment, industrial enclosures, or related electromechanical products.
* Strong understanding of metal fabrication, machining, painting, mechanical assembly, and electrical equipment assembly processes.
* Demonstrated success improving manufacturing productivity, on-time delivery, quality performance, workplace safety, and employee retention.
* Proven experience overseeing multiple manufacturing departments and leading production supervisors and operational teams.
* Strong working knowledge of Lean manufacturing, continuous improvement, ISO 9001, and OSHA requirements.
* Ability to interpret manufacturing workflows, understand engineering drawings, and work effectively with engineering and technical teams.
* Strong mechanical and technical aptitude with a hands-on approach to problem-solving.
* Experience with ERP systems, production scheduling, manufacturing KPIs, and operational reporting.
* Excellent leadership, communication, organizational, and decision-making skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations Management, or a related discipline; MBA preferred.
* Direct experience manufacturing electrical distribution cabinets, switchboards, panelboards, control cabinets, or telecommunications/data enclosures.
* Familiarity with electrical component integration, wiring, industrial equipment assembly, and final product testing.
* Experience managing manufacturing operations involving sheet metal fabrication, CNC machining, welding, and industrial finishing processes.
* Experience working within a global manufacturing organization and collaborating with international teams.
* Previous success leading operational turnarounds, implementing Lean initiatives, or improving underperforming manufacturing facilities.

**Ideal Candidate Profile:**

* The successful candidate will be a hands-on manufacturing leader with a strong technical foundation and experience managing complex fabrication and assembly operations.
* We are particularly interested in candidates who have managed facilities producing electrical cabinets, data and telecommunications enclosures, industrial electrical equipment, or similar fabricated and assembled products.
* This individual must be comfortable working directly with production teams, addressing manufacturing challenges, improving operational efficiency, and building a strong culture of safety, quality, and accountability.
